# Commands reliability hardening: Pull hooks, maintenance cancellation, and Amend recovery

The original Amend response-loss/restart scenario rewrote successfully but retry returned HTTP 409 because the original commit lacked a branch. Static review also found non-ASCII committer, publication/source-check, completed-view, and ancestor-hook-context blockers; do not claim Amend recovery support. [Task 3]

Scope: console.
